title: Senior Scrum Master - Safe Agile
description:
Job Title Senior Scrum Master - Safe Agile Job Summary Work Mode: WFO 5 Days Role Overview: We are looking for a highly skilled Scrum Master with strong expertise in JIRA, Safe Agile. The ideal candidate will be responsible to Support scrum, SAFe principles and practices, identifying and eliminating impediments, and facilitating flow etc Location: India Job Type: Full Time Responsibilities Facilitate custom application development projects using Agile methodology. Coordinate with different project, business teams, scrum teams, technical teams, and end-users in achieving the corporate deliverables on-time. Capture meeting notes and track action items. Strong interaction with the Business, Business Process Engineer, Super Users, Systems Analysts, Software Specialists, UX Developers and Project Managers are essential. Collaborate with other IT and Business teams to enable the Project teams with high delivery standards. Have the capability to understand web and mobile development languages like AWS Cloud, Angular, JavaScript, .Net, HTML5/CSS, SAP etc. and able to work with them to meet the business requirements. Ability to handle the team dynamics. Sound knowledge in SAFe Agile practice. Should have good communication skills. Should possess fundamental knowledge on cloud platform. Prototyping Mindset in terms of Design thinking/Design Sprint approach with team. Display Servant leadership and enable the Agile practices within the team through practice. Solid experience in Sprint activities, identifying priorities and dependencies. Good experience in effectively managing the product backlog using JIRA . Arrange and optimize product backlog. Help communicate the owner s wish list to the project team. Organize scrum ceremonies. Ensure project deliverables are delivered on time with right quality as per IFF standard practice and guideline. Good Experience in Risk identification and mitigation. Track and control the schedule, resources, and costs. Coach Teams in Best Practices to achieve common project goal. Ability to drive 2 or more Scrum teams. Facilitate Scrum Collaborations and co-ordinate with the project stake holders. Facilitate the end-to-end lifecycle of AIML models, including ideation, prototyping, experimentation, production deployment, and ongoing monitoring. Competency: Knowledge of AI/ML concepts and experience in managing projects involving AI/ML technologies (good to have) Implement changes and steps to increase the team s productivity. Collaborate with other scrum masters to improve the methodologies efficiency. Remove impediments and foster an environment for high-performing team dynamics. Support SAFe principles and practices, identifying and eliminating impediments, and facilitating flow. Helps the team coordinate with other teams on the Agile Release Train (ART). Able to collaborate and work closely with Cloud/Infrastructure team and handle the change requests/deployments. Experience Criteria Total Enterprise experience 6+ Years. 4+ Years in collaborative project delivery who comes with technical background and handling projects in agile mode of delivery. Background/Academic Qualification Bachelors /Post Graduate degree or higher in science or engineering. MBA or other advanced degree is a plus. Courses AWS Fundamentals Specialization. (Good to have) Design Sprint. (Good to have) Atlassian Jira Fundamentals. (Must) Reporting in Jira Software. (Must) Gain Project Insights through JQL. (Good to have) Job Relevant Competencies Good in presentation skills. Strong MS Office skills (Excel / PPT/ Word etc.,). Project management Tool - Atlassian JIRA. Good in Communication skills (Verbal and Written). Solid teamwork and interpersonal skills; meet challenging timelines. Ability to establish and maintain a high level of customer trust and confidence. Ability to deliver prototypes/proof of concepts in design sprint mode. Required Skills 6+yrs as Scrum Master, with Safe Agile project Experience. Good to Have Safe Agile certitication.

title: Junior Scrum Master
description:
Job Title: Scrum Master 
 
 Experience Required: 2+ year
Location : Chennai ( Maduravayol) 
Work from office 
Male candidate preffered
Shift timing : 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM
 Employment Type: Full-time
Good Communication 
 
About the Role
 
Were looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Scrum Master with at least 2 years of hands-on experience facilitating Agile/Scrum practices. Youll work closely with development teams, product owners, and stakeholders to ensure smooth delivery of projects while championing Agile values and continuous improvement.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
Coach and mentor the team on Agile/Scrum principles, values, and practices
Remove impediments and blockers that hinder team progress
Collaborate with Product Owners to maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog
Track and report sprint progress using tools like Jira, Trello, or Azure DevOps
Foster a collaborative, self-organizing team environment
Identify process improvements and drive their implementation
Manage stakeholder communication and expectations
Help resolve conflicts within the team constructively
Ensure adherence to Scrum framework while adapting practices to team needs
 
Required Skills & Qualifications
 
2+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or in an Agile facilitation role
Solid understanding of Scrum framework, Agile methodologies (Kanban, SAFe is a plus)
Hands-on experience with Agile project management tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello, etc.)
Strong communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure
Problem-solving mindset with a focus on team empowerment
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience)
 
Preferred Qualifications
 
CSM (Certified Scrum Master), PSM I/II, or equivalent certification
Experience working with cross-functional/distributed teams
